name: CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing
known_before: Bacterial CRISPR adaptive immunity; Cas9 is RNA-guided nuclease; ZFNs and TALENs for gene editing
actual: Cas9 + guide RNA = programmable DNA cleavage in eukaryotes
missing: Recognition that bacterial immunity is a programmable engineering tool

name: mRNA vaccines
known_before: Modified nucleosides reduce RNA immunogenicity; lipid nanoparticles deliver nucleic acids; viral spike proteins trigger immunity
actual: Nucleoside-modified mRNA + LNP delivery = vaccine platform
missing: Recognition that combining both solves the delivery + stability + immunogenicity problem simultaneously

name: Lithium-ion battery
known_before: LiCoO2 cathode intercalation; graphite anode intercalation; lithium metal batteries unsafe
actual: LiCoO2 cathode + graphite anode + non-aqueous electrolyte = rechargeable battery
missing: Recognition that combining two intercalation mechanisms creates a safe reversible system

name: PCR
known_before: DNA polymerase extends primers; heat denatures DNA; thermophilic bacteria have heat-stable enzymes
actual: Thermal cycling + Taq polymerase = exponential DNA amplification
missing: Recognition that cycling temperature with a thermostable enzyme enables exponential amplification

name: Graphene
known_before: Theory says 2D crystals thermodynamically unstable; graphite is layered carbon; carbon nanotubes exist
actual: Mechanical exfoliation produces stable single-layer graphene on substrate
missing: Recognition that the thermodynamic argument is wrong for supported 2D crystals

name: Transformer architecture
known_before: RNNs process sequentially (slow, vanishing gradients); attention improves seq2seq; self-attention used in some models
actual: Self-attention alone + positional encoding = Transformer (no recurrence)
missing: Recognition that recurrence can be entirely replaced by attention

name: AlexNet / deep learning
known_before: CNNs exist (LeNet); GPUs exist; ImageNet exists; ReLU exists; dropout exists
actual: Deep CNN + GPU + ImageNet + ReLU + dropout = breakthrough performance
missing: Recognition that combining all five at scale works

name: Penicillin
known_before: Bacteria cause infections; antiseptics are tissue-toxic; some molds inhibit bacteria (observed)
actual: Penicillium mold produces penicillin, inhibiting bacterial cell walls without harming tissue
missing: Recognition that a mold contaminant produces a non-toxic antibacterial substance

name: Monoclonal antibodies
known_before: Antibodies are specific; B-cells produce antibodies; myeloma cells grow indefinitely; cell fusion possible
actual: B-cell + myeloma fusion = hybridoma producing monoclonal antibodies indefinitely
missing: Recognition that fusing B-cells with immortal cells creates unlimited specific antibody production

name: Checkpoint immunotherapy anti-PD-1
known_before: PD-1 suppresses T-cell response; CTLA-4 blockade works in melanoma; cancer vaccines failing
actual: Blocking PD-1 releases T-cell inhibition = immune attack on tumors
missing: Recognition that removing the brake (not pressing the gas) enables immune response

name: RNA interference
known_before: Antisense RNA exists; plant cosuppression observed; C. elegans genetics
actual: Double-stranded RNA triggers conserved gene silencing via Dicer/Argonaute
missing: Recognition that dsRNA (not ssRNA) is the active agent, conserved across kingdoms

name: Induced pluripotent stem cells
known_before: ES cells exist; differentiation considered irreversible; nuclear transfer works but needs egg cytoplasm
actual: Four transcription factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc) reprogram somatic cells
missing: Recognition that defined factors can reverse differentiation without egg cytoplasm

name: Statins
known_before: HMG-CoA reductase is rate-limiting enzyme; microbial screening for antibiotics
actual: Fungal metabolites inhibit HMG-CoA reductase, lowering cholesterol
missing: Recognition that microbial secondary metabolites can inhibit mammalian enzymes

name: GFP fluorescent tag
known_before: GFP from jellyfish; GFP gene cloned; fluorescent dyes need chemical conjugation
actual: GFP can be genetically fused to any protein for live-cell visualization
missing: Recognition that a self-sufficient fluorescent protein works as a universal genetic tag

name: Perovskite solar cells
known_before: Dye-sensitized solar cells; perovskites known as materials; organic-inorganic halides as sensitizers
actual: Perovskite is both absorber AND charge transporter, not just a sensitizer
missing: Recognition that the auxiliary material is actually the primary functional material

name: Quantum Hall effect
known_before: Classical Hall effect; 2D electron gases; MOSFET physics
actual: Hall conductance is exactly quantized in integer multiples of e²/h
missing: Recognition that precision measurement reveals topological quantization

name: Haber-Bosch process
known_before: Le Chatelier's principle; catalysis; N2 considered inert; high-pressure chemistry
actual: High pressure + iron catalyst + optimized temperature = ammonia synthesis
missing: Recognition that combining Le Chatelier + catalysis + engineering overcomes the barrier

name: Metformin
known_before: French lilac treats excessive urination; insulin discovered
actual: Biguanide from French lilac reduces hepatic glucose via AMPK
missing: Recognition that a folk medicine plant contains a metabolic disease drug

name: Bacteriophage therapy
known_before: Bacteria are pathogens; no antibacterial drugs; phages discovered as bacterial killers
actual: Bacterial viruses used therapeutically to kill pathogenic bacteria
missing: Recognition that a pathogen (virus) can be medicine

name: Artemisinin
known_before: Quinine resistance spreading; traditional Chinese medicine texts describe sweet wormwood for fever
actual: Sesquiterpene lactone from Artemisia annua kills malaria parasites via ROS
missing: Recognition that a 1600-year-old text contains a valid antimalarial compound

name: Aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid)
known_before: Willow bark (salicin) used since antiquity; salicylic acid too irritating to stomach
actual: Acetylation of salicylic acid preserves therapeutic effect while reducing irritation
missing: Recognition that a simple chemical modification solves the key limitation

name: AlphaFold
known_before: Protein folding considered intractable; homology modeling exists; deep learning in biology
actual: Attention network + evolutionary covariance = near-experimental structure prediction
missing: Recognition that attention architecture + MSA data solves the folding problem

name: CAR-T cell therapy
known_before: T-cells kill cancer; chimeric receptors exist; viral vectors can modify T-cells
actual: Chimeric antigen receptor + T-cell = engineered cell that targets specific cancer
missing: Recognition that combining CAR engineering with T-cell infusion creates living drugs

name: Lithium iron phosphate cathode
known_before: LiCoO2 cathodes dominate; LiFePO4 known but considered insulating and unusable
actual: LiFePO4 with carbon coating is a safe, stable cathode material
missing: Recognition that nanosizing + carbon coating overcomes the conductivity problem

name: Organic LEDs (OLED)
known_before: Organic semiconductors exist; electroluminescence known; thin film deposition available
actual: Double-layer organic thin film produces efficient electroluminescence
missing: Recognition that a two-layer structure dramatically improves OLED efficiency

name: Quantum dots for displays
known_before: Semiconductor nanocrystals known; quantum confinement theory understood; colloidal synthesis emerging
actual: Colloidal quantum dots with tunable emission for displays
missing: Recognition that colloidal synthesis produces monodisperse nanocrystals with size-tunable color

name: Pulsed field gel electrophoresis
known_before: Gel electrophoresis exists; large DNA fragments break under constant field; orthogonal fields known
actual: Alternating orthogonal fields separate megabase DNA fragments
missing: Recognition that pulsing the field prevents DNA breakage while enabling separation

name: Next-gen sequencing (Illumina)
known_before: Sanger sequencing; bridge amplification; reversible terminators; fluorescence detection
actual: Bridge amplification + reversible terminators + parallel imaging = massive parallel sequencing
missing: Recognition that combining reversible chemistry with parallel imaging enables massive throughput

name: Flow batteries
known_before: Batteries store energy in solid electrodes (limited by electrode material); redox reactions in solution known
actual: Redox-active species in flowing electrolyte = decoupled power and capacity
missing: Recognition that moving the energy storage to the fluid decouples power from capacity

name: 3D printing (FDM)
known_before: Plastic extrusion exists; layer-by-layer manufacturing concept; CAD/CAM available
actual: Fused deposition of thermoplastic filament layer by layer = 3D printing
missing: Recognition that simple extrusion of filament can create arbitrary 3D objects

name: CRISPR diagnostics (SHERLOCK)
known_before: CRISPR-Cas13 cleaves RNA; collateral cleavage activity known; lateral flow assays exist
actual: Cas13 collateral cleavage + reporter = programmable nucleic acid detection
missing: Recognition that CRISPR's collateral cleavage can be repurposed as a diagnostic signal

name: GANs (Generative Adversarial Networks)
known_before: Generative models exist; discriminative models exist; adversarial training concept in game theory
actual: Generator + discriminator in adversarial training = high-quality generation
missing: Recognition that pitting two networks against each other creates a powerful generative system

name: Organ-on-chip
known_before: Microfluidics exist; cell culture exists; tissue engineering emerging
actual: Microfluidic channels + living cells = organ-mimicking system for drug testing
missing: Recognition that combining microfluidics with cell culture creates physiological models

name: Solid-state battery
known_before: Liquid electrolytes have safety issues; solid electrolytes have low conductivity; LiPON exists
actual: Sulfide-based solid electrolyte achieves high ionic conductivity at room temperature
missing: Recognition that new solid electrolyte chemistry removes the conductivity constraint

name: Click chemistry
known_before: Organic synthesis is complex with low yields; bioconjugation is difficult; specific reactions known
actual: Copper-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition = reliable, specific, modular reaction
missing: Recognition that a modular, reliable reaction enables universal bioconjugation

name: Distributed acoustic sensing
known_before: Fiber optic cables for telecom; Rayleigh scattering in fibers; seismology needs sensors
actual: Standard fiber optic cable + laser interferometry = distributed seismic sensor
missing: Recognition that telecom infrastructure can be repurposed as a continuous sensor

name: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs)
known_before: Porous materials exist (zeolites); metal carboxylate coordination chemistry; reticular synthesis concept
actual: Metal nodes + organic linkers = crystalline porous materials with tunable properties
missing: Recognition that metal-organic coordination creates designable porous materials

name: Photoredox catalysis
known_before: Ruthenium photoredox catalysts known; visible light photocatalysis; radical chemistry
actual: Photoredox catalyst + visible light = mild, selective radical generation for synthesis
missing: Recognition that visible-light photoredox enables previously impossible mild radical reactions

name: Spatial transcriptomics
known_before: RNA-seq exists; microscopy exists; tissue sectioning standard; barcoding technology
actual: Barcoded spots on tissue + RNA-seq = gene expression with spatial context
missing: Recognition that combining positional barcoding with sequencing preserves spatial information

name: Reinforcement learning for protein design
known_before: RL exists for games; protein structure prediction improving; de novo protein design is hard
actual: RL + protein structure model = designed proteins with novel folds
missing: Recognition that RL (from game theory) transfers to the protein folding landscape

name: Water splitting photocatalyst
known_before: TiO2 is a semiconductor; photoelectrochemistry known; water electrolysis exists
actual: TiO2 electrode under UV light splits water into H2 and O2
missing: Recognition that a semiconductor can use light to drive water splitting

name: Lithium-sulfur battery
known_before: Sulfur has high theoretical capacity; polysulfide dissolution causes capacity fade; nanostructured carbons exist
actual: Nanostructured carbon-sulfur composite + interlayer = mitigated polysulfide dissolution
missing: Recognition that nanostructuring + interlayers remove the polysulfide dissolution constraint

name: mRNA cap analogs
known_before: mRNA needs a 5' cap for translation; natural caps inefficient; in vitro transcription exists
actual: Anti-reverse cap analog (ARCA) = efficiently capped mRNA for translation
missing: Recognition that modifying cap chemistry solves the orientation problem

name: Tetracycline-inducible system
known_before: Tetracycline resistance genes exist; gene expression control is manual; prokaryotic regulatory systems
actual: TetR + tetracycline = reversible mammalian gene expression control
missing: Recognition that a bacterial resistance system can control mammalian gene expression

name: Photolithography microfabrication
known_before: Photoresists exist; UV light exposure; chemical etching; planar process for transistors
actual: Photolithography + etching + deposition = planar microfabrication of integrated circuits
missing: Recognition that combining photolithography with etching enables mass IC production

name: Magnetic resonance imaging
known_before: NMR exists; magnetic field gradients known; Fourier transform reconstruction; RF coils
actual: NMR + gradient coils + Fourier reconstruction = non-invasive medical imaging
missing: Recognition that adding gradients to NMR enables spatial encoding for imaging

name: Pluripotent stem cell differentiation
known_before: ES cells exist; growth factors known; embryoid bodies; developmental biology
actual: Sequential growth factor treatment = directed differentiation to specific lineages
missing: Recognition that timed growth factor exposure recapitulates developmental signals

name: Zinc-air battery
known_before: Zinc electrodes exist; oxygen from air is free; aqueous electrolytes; primary batteries dominate
actual: Zinc anode + air cathode = high energy density battery using atmospheric oxygen
missing: Recognition that using air as cathode removes the weight constraint of solid cathodes

name: Organocatalysis
known_before: Catalysis needs metals or enzymes; organic molecules considered substrates not catalysts; enamine chemistry known
actual: Small organic molecules (proline) catalyze asymmetric reactions without metals
missing: Recognition that organic molecules can be catalysts, not just substrates

name: AlphaFold2 Evoformer
known_before: Multiple sequence alignments contain co-evolution info; attention mechanisms exist; structure prediction is hard
actual: Evoformer (attention over MSA + pair features) + structure module = atomic accuracy
missing: Recognition that jointly attending to sequence and pair features solves the structure problem
